niche_preference_profile: Prefers light neutral interfaces with dark text and restrained purple accents, spacious layouts, clear card/section structure, strong but clean information hierarchy, refined rounded components with subtle depth, explicit text labeling, and minimal decorative noise. Tends to reject dark high-contrast/neon-heavy UIs, dense stacking, oversized graphics, and overly promotional or visually busy treatments.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers light neutral backgrounds or light content areas, often paired with dark text and restrained purple accents; generally rejects mostly dark, blue-black, navy, or neon-heavy themes.
Prefers more open spacing, fewer visible items, and less compressed compositions; rejects dense, tightly stacked, or visually crowded layouts.
Prefers strong hierarchy with clear titles, helper text, readable grouping, aligned sections, and obvious focal structure; rejects weak grouping, faint hierarchy, or competing elements.
Prefers organized card-based layouts, ordered sections, divided rows, and enclosed containers that create clear structure and separation.
Prefers minimal decorative effects, restrained accents, and cleaner presentation with limited visual competition; rejects gradients, glowing effects, spread accenting, and decorative clutter.
Prefers rounded cards, subtle shadows, soft surfaces, gentle borders, and polished component styling over flat, harsh, or minimally defined elements.
Prefers full-text labels, text-labeled actions, concise readable copy, and clearly named metrics or roles rather than abbreviations, icon-only actions, or overly verbose text blocks.
